notes.title: What to do if the controller does not work
notes.content:
If the controller does not work at startup, please follow the procedure below to set up the controller.

[h1]Press the controller icon[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44609958/7583184e7bf829cbcaa11d2c4665aa3d3d474f03.png[/img]

[h1]Select a recommended gamepad or a gamepad from the template.[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44609958/89b4faef6931491e24d4fe541ea3d8ddc5d595fb.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44609958/1ed01e00099d1804773e08aa0302b541a88dd85b.png[/img]

[h1]Click on the settings icon[/h1]
Select the controller from the properties of the settings, and confirm that the controller is recognized in the controller section.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44609958/f03035b2c56e7279900e63067dc73b101616bd22.png[/img]

notes.title: We have temporarily closed the purchase button
notes.content:
We have temporarily closed the purchase button due to the issue of being able to purchase before the release date.

Thank you for your continued support of "Get me out,Please".

"Get me out,Please" was scheduled to be released on 10/26, but due to an error in our publish settings, the game became available for purchase earlier than planned on 10/10.
We contacted Steam support on the same day, and today the purchase button has been made private, and the game is currently unavailable for purchase.

The game will be available again on 10/26.

We apologize for any inconvenience and concern this may cause.

Satoshi Kano, Producer of "Get me out,Please"

notes.title: Regarding the "controller not recognized" problem.
notes.content:
We are currently receiving reports of a problem on Steam where some controllers are not recognized.
We are currently investigating and fixing this issue.
We will update the software on October 26.

We apologize for any concern or inconvenience this may cause.
